Enhanced Senses.Description: Advantage on non-attack tests that rely on smell.

Minion.Description: Attacks can't crit, and they're defeated once they suffer an injury.

Strike: Bite.Description: Attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 1d4 keen damage. Hit: 1d4 + 4 keen damage, and if the target is Medium or smaller, the axehound can spend 1 focus to knock the target Prone, then move up to 10 feet while dragging the target behind them.

Pack Instincts.Description: While within 5 feet of an ally, the axehound can use the Gain Advantage action as ▷.

On the Hunt.Description: After an enemy within 30 feet of the axehound falls Prone, the axehound moves up to 15 feet toward them.

Track.Description: The animal companion helps their Hunter track one character of the Hunter’s choice who the animal companion can sense within their reach. The target becomes the Hunter’s quarry for their Seek Quarry talent.
